title: 52-week-high proximity predicts the next 10 NSE sessions' cross-sectional returns
mechanism: Anchoring: investors use the 52-week high as a reference point and under-react to news when a price is near it, so stocks close to their 52-week high drift up relative to stocks far from it (George and Hwang, 2004, Journal of Finance 59(5)). India-specific evidence is not assumed; that is what this test measures.
disclosure: The author has seen in-sample walk-forward diagnostics of the scanner's event signals (for example BREAKOUT_52W at +0.33R on 8 trades in a 40-symbol probe). This thesis is a cross-sectional ranking, not that event signal, and was chosen from the external literature, not from those numbers. No historical return of this score was computed before freezing.

universe.membership: point-in-time: listed on or before the decision session and not delisted by it (logs/universe_history.json, official bhavcopy)
universe.price_source: official NSE bhavcopy, corporate-action adjusted on read

score.name: high_52w_proximity
score.definition: close(d) / max(high over the 252 official sessions ending at d, inclusive)
score.data_through: decision session d only (no bar after d)

schedule.decision_sessions: every 10th official NSE session, starting at the first official session strictly after the freeze date
schedule.freeze_deadline: the score vector is frozen in the shadow ledger before 09:15 IST of the next calendar day (product.challenger_shadow rules); a session not frozen in time is MISSED, never backfilled
schedule.entry: open of the official session after d
schedule.exit: close of the 10th official session after d

primary_outcome.statistic: Spearman rank correlation (IC) between score(d) and the entry-to-exit return across the eligible universe, one value per decision session
primary_outcome.independence: decision sessions are 10 sessions apart, so outcome windows never overlap; each IC is one independent block
primary_outcome.hypothesis: H0: mean IC <= 0; H1: mean IC > 0
primary_outcome.test: one-sided t-test on the per-block IC series
primary_outcome.multiplicity: a single pre-registered hypothesis (m = 1), outside the walk-forward BUY family and its annual budget

secondary_outcomes: equal-weight top-20 basket return, net of 0.32% round-trip cost (core.costs CNC 0.22% + 0.10% slippage), minus the equal-weight eligible-universe return, per block, with a 95% interval; descriptive unless the primary passes
the same IC within BULL / CHOP / BEAR blocks of the equal-weight index (scan.signal_backtest.classify_regime); descriptive only

power.sensitivity_note: required_blocks = ceil(((z_0.95 + z_0.80) * sd / effect)^2); the sample size is fixed at 69 and is never reduced after any look at the data

stopping.futility_rule: non-binding: stop for futility if the mean IC at 35 blocks is <= 0
stopping.inconclusive_if: more than 10% of decision sessions are MISSED, or fewer than 500 eligible symbols on more than 10% of decision sessions

missing_data.symbol_without_complete_window: excluded from that block's IC and counted

decision_on_result.PASS: permits proposing a separate, owner-approved paper-only experiment; never a BUY, never a change to the live gate or risk limits
decision_on_result.FAIL_OR_FUTILE: the thesis is recorded as not supported in India for this horizon
decision_on_result.INCONCLUSIVE: reported as such; no extension without a new pre-registration
